detailed_findings.finding: The induction identifying T_t(e_i)_j with the number of admissible t-chains is correct and matches the U/D recurrence exactly.
The proof does not use nonnegativity of x, so it actually proves a slightly stronger comparison for all weakly monotone x; this is harmless and not semantic drift.

reason: The proof is complete and internally coherent. It correctly expresses Total∘T_t as a linear functional on x, identifies the coefficients via an induction that counts admissible chains, proves strict monotonicity of the coefficient sequence for Alt_r^+ by an inclusion-plus-witness argument, derives the Alt_r^- coefficients by an explicit involutive reflection bijection, and then finishes by pairing symmetric indices to compare the two totals for monotone x. The strictness arguments for nonconstant weakly monotone x are also valid. No forbidden or undeclared dependencies are used.
